description: This file contains the implementation of the Zend_Validate_Hostname class, which is a validator for DNS hostnames including support for IDN and IP address validation. It includes methods for configuration, hostname validation logic, and support for Punycode decoding.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_Hostname
classes.description: A validator class for validating DNS hostnames, including support for IDN (Internationalized Domain Names), IP addresses, and local hostnames. It provides configuration options for allowed hostname types and TLD validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes validator options, allowing configuration of hostname types, IDN validation, TLD validation, and IP validation through an options array or Zend_Config object.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns the current configuration options of the validator.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets multiple configuration options for the validator, such as allow types, IDN and TLD validation, and IP validator.

methods.name: getIpValidator
methods.description: Retrieves the current IP validator object used for IP address validation.

methods.name: setIpValidator
methods.description: Sets a custom IP validator object or reinitializes the default one for validating IP addresses.

methods.name: getAllow
methods.description: Returns the current allow setting, indicating which hostname types are permitted.

methods.name: setAllow
methods.description: Sets the allow option to specify permitted hostname types (e.g., DNS, IP, local).

methods.name: getValidateIdn
methods.description: Returns whether IDN validation is enabled.

methods.name: setValidateIdn
methods.description: Enables or disables validation of Internationalized Domain Names.

methods.name: getValidateTld
methods.description: Returns whether TLD validation is enabled.

methods.name: setValidateTld
methods.description: Enables or disables validation of the TLD component in hostnames.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Performs the hostname validation logic, checking for correct hostname structure, allowed TLDs, IDN support, dash placement, and IP addresses according to configuration.

methods.name: decodePunycode
methods.description: Decodes a Punycode-encoded string into Unicode; used for IDN hostname label decoding. Returns false if decoding fails.
